Nathan Bronson and colleagues described them in 2021, and Lexiang Huang and colleagues found them in production systems at many companies the year after. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is our retrying server from chapter three, hit by triggers of different sizes: its capacity falls to some fraction of normal, for some number of seconds. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 7 of these 20 cases the system is still collapsed a minute after the trigger has gone, held there by its own retries. <bookmark mark='c'/> The boundary between green and red is the thing an operator most needs to know, and today it is found by experiment, or by an outage. There is no general theory that predicts it from a system's design.
91b6ff0264de.zh: 亚稳态故障是前沿上最尖锐的问题。Nathan Bronson 和同事在2021年描述了它们，而 Lexiang Huang 和同事在第二年，在许多公司的生产系统中发现了它们。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是我们第三章那台会重试的服务器，受到不同大小的触发因素的冲击：它的容量降到正常值的某个比例，持续若干秒。<bookmark mark='b'/>在这20种情况中，有7种在触发因素消失一分钟之后，系统仍然处于崩溃状态，被它自己的重试困在那里。<bookmark mark='c'/>绿色和红色之间的边界，是运维人员最需要知道的东西，而今天它要靠实验，或者靠一次中断才能找到。还没有一般性的理论能根据一个系统的设计来预测它。

f03947aea808.en: Three lines of research. <bookmark mark='a'/> Models of metastability: queueing models and simulators that find the boundary between recovery and collapse, so that it can be designed for rather than discovered. <bookmark mark='b'/> Safer change: since most outages follow a change, progressive delivery, automatic rollback, and checking configuration the way we check code. <bookmark mark='c'/> And machines on call: language models that read alerts, logs and past incidents and propose a root cause. Microsoft and others have published studies of such systems; their suggestions are still judged by people. <bookmark mark='d'/> Under all three sits one open question: how to state and check guarantees about a running system as a whole.
f03947aea808.zh: 三条研究方向。<bookmark mark='a'/>亚稳态的模型：用排队模型和模拟器找出恢复与崩溃之间的边界，这样就能事先针对它来设计，而不是事后才发现它。<bookmark mark='b'/>更安全的变更：既然大多数中断都发生在一次变更之后，那就有渐进式交付、自动回滚，以及像检查代码那样检查配置。<bookmark mark='c'/>还有值班的机器：阅读告警、日志和过去的事故，并提出根本原因的语言模型。Microsoft 和其他公司已经发表了对这类系统的研究；它们的建议仍然由人来判断。<bookmark mark='d'/>这三条方向之下，有一个共同的开放问题：如何对一个运行中的系统整体陈述并检验保证。

72fa30e6ac00.en: Open problems. <bookmark mark='a'/> Predicting from a design which triggers it will survive. <bookmark mark='b'/> Detecting gray failure quickly, with few false alarms, from users' own requests. <bookmark mark='c'/> Deciding how slowly to roll out a change, for a given appetite for risk. <bookmark mark='d'/> And finding root causes from telemetry: which signals are enough, and how far a model's answer can be trusted. <bookmark mark='e'/> This part's research problem asks for the map we just drew, derived rather than simulated: for a server of given capacity, load, timeout and retry policy, the exact set of triggers after which it can no longer recover, with a proof.
72fa30e6ac00.zh: 未解决的问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>根据一个设计，预测它能扛过哪些触发因素。<bookmark mark='b'/>根据用户自己的请求，快速地检测灰色故障，并且误报很少。<bookmark mark='c'/>对于给定的风险偏好，决定一项变更应该推出得多慢。<bookmark mark='d'/>还有根据遥测数据找出根本原因：哪些信号就够了，以及一个模型的答案能被信任到什么程度。<bookmark mark='e'/>这一部分的研究题要求的，正是我们刚刚画出的那张图，只不过要推导出来，而不是模拟出来：对于一台给定容量、负载、超时和重试策略的服务器，找出在其之后它再也无法恢复的那些触发因素的精确集合，并给出证明。

f9b836f6897d.en: What we built in this part. Availability that multiplies in series and is rescued in parallel, until a common cause breaks the independence it relies on. An error budget, and alerts derived from it that page quickly for real trouble and stay quiet for blips. Retries that can hold a system in collapse long after the trigger, and the backoff, jitter and budgets that prevent it. Breakers, bulkheads, shedding, ejection and hedges. Metrics, sketches, traces and profiles that do not lie, and load generators that do. And the Job's own service, broken on purpose, kept within its objective. One idea runs through it: reliability is not hoped for, it is measured and paid for.
f9b836f6897d.zh: 这一部分我们构建了什么。可用性：串联时相乘，并联时得到挽救，直到一个共同原因打破了它所依赖的独立性。一份错误预算，以及由它推导出的告警，对真正的麻烦迅速呼叫，对小波动保持安静。重试：它能在触发因素消失很久之后，仍把一个系统困在崩溃中，还有防止这种情况的退避、抖动和预算。断路器、舱壁、负载削减、剔除和对冲。不会说谎的指标、草图、追踪和剖析数据，以及会说谎的负载生成器。还有那项任务自己的服务，被故意破坏，却保持在它的目标之内。一个思想贯穿其中：可靠性不是靠期望得来的，而是被测量出来、用代价换来的。

f98ffda4c323.en: Where this comes back. Part 51 renders frames against a sixteen-millisecond budget, an objective of its own. Part 54 proves protocols and configurations correct before they ship. Part 55 asks whether the software we deploy can be trusted at all. Part 59 returns to the theory of distributed algorithms and what they cannot do. And Part 60 builds hardware for one job, where every watt is budgeted.
f98ffda4c323.zh: 这些内容会在哪里再出现。第51部分在16毫秒的预算内渲染每一帧，这是它自己的一个目标。第54部分在协议和配置上线之前证明它们是正确的。第55部分追问我们部署的软件到底能不能被信任。第59部分回到分布式算法的理论，以及它们做不到什么。而第60部分为单一的一种工作专门构建硬件，在那里每一瓦都有预算。

a938fdd86003.en: In practice. Define objectives in the terms your users feel, and an error budget the whole team agrees to spend. Alert on how fast the budget is burning, over a long and a short window, rather than on every symptom. Retry with timeouts, jitter and a budget, and never at every layer at once. Measure latency with histograms or sketches, from the time a request should have been sent. And learn from failure: blameless post-mortems, and chaos experiments that start with a small blast radius.
a938fdd86003.zh: 实践中。用用户能感受到的语言来定义目标，并定一份整个团队都同意花费的错误预算。根据预算消耗得多快来告警，用一个长窗口和一个短窗口，而不是对每一个症状都告警。重试时要带上超时、抖动和预算，而且绝不在每一层同时重试。用直方图或草图来测量延迟，从一个请求本应被发送的时刻算起。还要从失败中学习：不追责的事后复盘，以及从很小的爆炸半径开始的混沌实验。

8bc5976e47e2.en: Six problems, with full solutions in the part's notes. Pause on any of them. The fifth is a build problem: add a circuit breaker and a retry budget to a client, and measure what they do through a drop in capacity. The last, marked with a star, is a research problem: derive, rather than simulate, the triggers from which a retrying server cannot recover.
8bc5976e47e2.zh: 六道习题，完整解答在这一部分的笔记里。可以在任何一道上暂停。第五道是构建题：给一个客户端加上断路器和重试预算，并测量在一次容量下降期间它们起了什么作用。最后一道标有星号，是研究题：推导出，而不是模拟出，那些会让一台会重试的服务器无法恢复的触发因素。

30245b67500c.en: Next time, Part 51, which opens Act Ten, Horizons and Trust: light and pixels. A picture is millions of samples of light. Projecting triangles onto a screen is linear algebra plus one division; getting the samples right is Nyquist again; and the physics of light is one integral equation, which our own path tracer solves one bounced ray at a time.
30245b67500c.zh: 下一次，第51部分，它将开启第十幕“视野与信任”：光与像素。一幅图像是数以百万计的光的样本。把三角形投影到屏幕上，是线性代数再加一次除法；把样本取对，又是 Nyquist；而光的物理是一个积分方程，我们自己的路径追踪器一次追踪一条反弹的光线来求解它。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
9bd24692775d.zh: 这一部分所依据的书和论文都在屏幕上和笔记里。感谢观看。
